title: 贴身绑爆弹的快递员：披萨炸弹劫案（2003）
style_prefix: Stylized 2D animated documentary illustration with hand-painted graphic-novel textures and soft cel shading, small-city Erie Pennsylvania in late summer 2003: strip-mall banks, a family pizzeria, a broadcast tower on a dirt road, suburban garages, early-2010s American federal interiors; horizontal 16:9 cinematic composition, period-correct 2003 cars, payphones and clothing, muted palette of brick red, lake gray, mustard yellow and teal shadow, overcast late-summer daylight or warm practical interior light, restrained melancholy documentary mood, no thriller excess; every character is shown only from behind, in silhouette, or as hands and props — never a clear frontal face; absolutely no readable text, letters, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere inside the frame; one single continuous smooth slow camera move per shot exactly as directed.
negative_prompt: readable text, letters, numbers, words, signage writing, invented headlines, logos, brand marks, watermark, subtitles, on-screen caption, photorealistic face, recognizable real person likeness, frontal face close-up, eyes visible in detail, blood, gore, wound, corpse, body parts, autopsy, explosion moment, fireball, detonation, smoke blast, gun, firearm, shotgun, weapon attack, hostage violence, injury, scream, modern smartphone, cars newer than 2005, neon cyberpunk, anime ecchi, manga speedlines, flat clipart, plastic 3D render, distorted anatomy, deformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, duplicated people, morphing face, changing face, melting features, asymmetric eyes, jitter, flicker, whip pan, fast zoom, rapid dolly-in, sudden camera jump, jump cut, vertical 9:16, low detail, blurry frames, dark muddy frame
principles: 全片为风格化动画情景重现，一律标注「AI情景重现 · 非历史影像」，不冒充真实影像或真实证物
真实人物（韦尔斯、三名被告与家属）在画面中一律不露正脸：只用背影、剪影、手部与道具，不用AI生成的脸冒充本人
爆炸装置只作为静态道具特写出现（依据警方公布的描述），不渲染起爆瞬间、伤亡与血腥
韦尔斯是共谋还是被胁迫：只并列呈现执法结论与家属说法两种口径，不裁决他有没有罪；不指认未在判决中出现的人
所有中文姓名、日期、数字与字幕一律后期添加，不交给视频模型拼写；画面内不出现品牌、伪文字与可读字母
运镜多样化：推、拉、摇、移、升降、跟、环绕、固定逐镜不同，禁止全片单一「从远到近飞入」
人工逐镜检视生成结果：严重畸变、露正脸或穿帮的镜头重新生成，不直接进入成片

chapters.title: 一通披萨订单
chapters.text: 二〇〇三年八月二十八日下午，宾夕法尼亚州伊利城，披萨店接到一通电话：两份披萨，送到城外的电视发射塔。四十六岁的布莱恩·韦尔斯在这家店跑了十年外卖，接下了这一单。塔下等着他的，不是小费，是一副锁上就摘不下来的金属领圈，和领圈上挂着的定时炸弹。

chapters.title: 银行里的纸条
chapters.text: 下午两点半，韦尔斯走进PNC银行，安静排队，嘴里还含着棒棒糖。轮到柜台，他递进一张纸条：把能开金库的人叫来，十五分钟，装够二十五万美元，不然脖子上的炸弹就响。金库开不了那么快，柜员只好把能凑出的八千七百零二美元，装进他的披萨袋。目击者后来说，他离开时摆弄纸袋和拐杖，像卓别林。

chapters.title: 九页纸
chapters.text: 他没跑，也没报警——纸条替他安排好了路线：先去隔壁快餐店取下一个线索。警方在他车里搜出九页手写指令，收件人写着：炸弹人质。纸上的说法是，找齐几把钥匙就能拖延引爆，最后一步给出拆弹暗号，每一步都有人盯着；页末一行大字：先行动，后思考，否则死。

chapters.title: 三点十八分
chapters.text: 离开银行约一刻钟后，韦尔斯被警察按倒铐在停车场。他冲警察喊：快炸了，我不骗你们。警方不敢碰领圈，只拉起封锁线等拆弹的人。三点零四分，拆弹队接到呼叫；三点十八分，炸弹抢先三分钟起爆。事后警方按九页纸条重跑任务路线，结论是：在时限之内，根本跑不完。

chapters.title: 冰柜
chapters.text: 案子卡了两年，栽在一台冰柜上。二〇〇三年九月，造弹的罗斯斯坦主动报警：自家车库冰柜里有一具尸体，死者是玛乔丽·迪尔-阿姆斯特朗的同居男友，据检方说法，他因知道太多被灭口。同案人在庭上作证：那副领圈，是她照着韦尔斯的脖子量了尺寸做的。而动机，检方只有一句话：凑二十五万美元，雇凶杀她父亲。

chapters.title: 判决之后
chapters.text: 二〇一〇年，陪审团裁定玛乔丽三项罪名成立，次年判无期加三十年，上诉全部被驳回。她当庭说：我不是疯子杀手，真凶还在外面；她至死把主谋推给罗斯斯坦——那人在起诉前便已病故，她自己在二〇一七年病死狱中。至于韦尔斯，是共谋还是替死鬼？警方与家属各执一词，至今没有第三种答案。

shots.camera: 高空横移 aerial lateral track
shots.prompt: late-summer small city of Erie Pennsylvania in 2003 seen from low altitude: a modest commercial strip with low brick storefronts and a big steel lattice broadcast transmitter tower on a tree-covered ridge far behind, two-lane roads with a few period sedans, gray-green Lake Erie light under broken cloud. Camera: one slow continuous aerial lateral tracking move left to right, ending with the transmitter tower at the right third of frame, never tilting into any face.
shots.purpose: 建立城市与全片的引线（发射塔）；片头镜
shots.transition_out: 高空横移接店内柜台前推

shots.camera: 柜台缓移 forward counter glide
shots.prompt: warm interior of a small family pizzeria in 2003, seen along the counter: stacked pizza boxes under heat lamps, an old cash register, a wall of framed kids' soccer photos, an employee's hands picking up the ringing desk phone behind the counter, a delivery polo shirt with a cap hanging on a peg at the far end; only hands and torso, no faces anywhere. Camera: one slow forward glide along the counter toward the ringing phone, ending one box-width short of the receiver.
shots.purpose: 订单电话进来——诱饵被挂断前的最后一环

shots.camera: 信息卡 static card
shots.purpose: 人物与时点事实卡（不依赖AI拼字）
shots.graphic: 一单披萨｜2003.08.28 下午 · 宾州伊利｜布莱恩·韦尔斯 · 46岁 · 跑了十年外卖

shots.camera: 侧向恒速跟移 constant side track
shots.prompt: a plain early-2000s economy sedan driving out of a small American city along a commercial strip toward a tree-lined radio-tower road, mid-afternoon light; shot from the opposite sidewalk at window height, the driver only a dark shape behind glare, an insulated pizza bag faintly on the passenger seat, storefronts sliding past. Camera: one constant-speed lateral side tracking move keeping the car centered and the distance fixed, ending as the buildings thin into trees; never cut to the windshield or show the driver.
shots.purpose: 接单上路：城市渐稀、路向发射塔

shots.camera: 背面缓推 slow glide from behind
shots.prompt: gravel pull-off at the base of a tall steel lattice broadcast transmitter tower surrounded by late-summer trees, dusk-light under cloud: a lone sedan parked with one headlight still on, a tall man seen strictly from behind standing beside the trunk facing the tower, hands at his sides, a second older pickup truck parked farther off in shadow; quiet, ominous, nothing touches him, no violence occurs in frame. Camera: one very slow glide toward the tower from behind the man, the tower growing to fill the top of the frame; the man stays back-to-camera for every frame.
shots.purpose: 塔下：陷阱收口的定格（不演暴力过程）
shots.transition_out: 缓推接银行门内低机位

shots.camera: 低机位固定+缓移 locked low angle with lateral drift
shots.prompt: quiet lobby of a mid-size American bank branch inside a strip mall in 2003, no brand: glass entry doors with a brushed push bar, a ticket dispenser, low counters behind bulletproof glass, potted palm, two customers seated with backs to camera; a man in a polo shirt enters and joins the queue seen from behind, everything orderly. Camera: low fixed wide angle from beside the door, with one subtle slow lateral drift left to right revealing the counter line; nobody turns to camera.
shots.purpose: 反差：像办业务一样的抢劫

shots.camera: 微距横扫 macro lateral glide
shots.prompt: extreme close-up at the bank counter glass slot: a man's hand pushes a folded handwritten note under the divider, the paper stays edge-on so no writing ever faces the camera; a wrapped lollipop rests on the little steel tray beside it, the teller's hands in plain 2003 business shirtsleeves pause mid-stamp and reach for the note; carpet, glass, counter rail only. Camera: one slow macro lateral glide across the counter surface following the note, ending as the teller's fingertips touch the paper; no faces.
shots.purpose: 纸条进柜台：劫案的唯一书面证据

shots.camera: 信息卡 static card
shots.purpose: 劫案条件卡：金额与时限两个硬数字
shots.graphic: 十五分钟｜要二十五万美元 · 从金库数出来｜领圈上挂着表 · 响不响不在他手里

shots.camera: 降臂俯拍 crane-down to overhead
shots.prompt: overhead view of a teller's hands counting a thin stack of mixed-denomination bills under a counter lamp and sliding them into a scuffed insulated pizza delivery bag; a lollipop stick discarded into a paper cup, a small rubber band box, green bank mat; the teller's forearms only; the money visibly less than requested. Camera: one slow vertical crane-down from just above the counter to a straight overhead at the bag, ending on the bag's zipper half-closed.
shots.purpose: 钱装进披萨袋——外卖逻辑的最荒诞一笔

shots.camera: 远景侧向跟移 long side follow
shots.prompt: frontage of a strip mall in gray afternoon light: a man walks out of the bank's glass doors at a loose rhythmic stride seen far from the side, one hand swinging the insulated pizza bag, the other carrying a slender plain walking stick held like a cane, shoulders loose, small in frame against the long building; nobody runs, no alarm visibly sounds. Camera: one steady lateral tracking shot at constant speed and distance, the storefront sliding behind him, ending as he passes frame right toward a parking lot; no gun, no face.
shots.purpose: 目击者的比喻：像卓别林

shots.camera: 过肩微浮 over-shoulder float
shots.prompt: interior of a cheap early-2000s economy car parked under a lot light: a pair of man's hands on the steering wheel holding a folded sheaf of many handwritten pages, the sheets kept angled so the writing never faces camera, the pages turning one by one; a lollipop stick on the dash, a pizza bag in the footwell; afternoon darkness leaking in; only hands and forearms. Camera: over-the-shoulder from the passenger seat, one micro slow forward float toward the pages, ending tight on the top sheet creasing between fingers.
shots.purpose: 九页纸：案子的剧本浮出水面

shots.camera: 缓慢拉远 slow pull-back reveal
shots.prompt: unbranded fast-food window built into the same strip mall, mid-afternoon: the same man approaching the side window seen from well behind, one hand at his belt, the other still holding the bank's paper pizza bag; a plastic menu panel glows blurred above him, nobody else near, the bank doors visible far behind him in the same frame. Camera: one slow pull-back beginning tight on the man's back and continuously revealing the whole plaza frontage and his place on the route, ending wide; never a face.
shots.purpose: 照单行动：他真去找下一个线索了

shots.camera: 信息卡 static card
shots.purpose: 任务清单卡：纸面与台词同源
shots.graphic: 九页纸｜找齐钥匙拖时限 · 末段给拆弹暗号｜页末大字：先行动 · 后思考 · 否则死

shots.camera: 微距缓移环绕 macro slow drift orbit
shots.prompt: controlled studio close-up of an inert museum-style prop reconstructed from police descriptions: a heavy three-band hinged metal collar resting open on dark cloth under a soft top light, a small dark box fixed to its front with one unlit digital display and a stubby antenna, a few unconnected wires and a plain sticker blank of any lettering; the object closed, safe, photographed like an artifact; no person in frame, nothing explodes, no danger shown. Camera: one very slow macro orbit of barely twenty degrees around the collar ending at a three-quarter view, keeping the display unlit and empty.
shots.purpose: 装置本体的证物式特写（仅静态道具）

shots.camera: 监控高角固定+极缓拉 locked high angle micro zoom-out
shots.prompt: high fixed angle like a rooftop security camera at late afternoon: a man seated on the curb at the edge of a business-park parking lot seen from behind above, shoulders slumped, a few officers standing well away below with their backs to the camera, an abandoned car door open nearby, empty asphalt, harsh flat light; everything frozen in procedure. Camera: locked-off high angle, one almost imperceptible slow zoom-out widening from the seated figure to the whole empty lot, ending with all people tiny; no faces.
shots.purpose: 被监视的人：路线上的一枚棋子

shots.camera: 升镜 crane-up establish
shots.prompt: a business-park parking lot cordoned off at mid-afternoon: two patrol cars parked at angles with light bars dark, four officers directing onlookers away seen from behind, a distant seated figure surrounded by cones behind them, strip-mall glass reflecting flat cloud; no ambulance yet, no flashing chaos, procedural calm. Camera: one slow unbroken crane-up rising from officer height to a wide high view over the whole lot, ending with the cones forming a small ring around the seated man.
shots.purpose: 封锁线：谁都不敢碰那圈金属

shots.camera: 信息卡 static card
shots.purpose: 时间卡：两个时刻一个差值
shots.graphic: 三分钟之差｜三点零四分 拆弹队接到呼叫｜三点十八分 装置起爆 · 只早三分钟

shots.camera: 过肩缓推 slow glide over shoulder
shots.prompt: from behind an officer's shoulder at the cordon edge: a handcuffed man seated against the curb facing away from camera, his head turned in strict profile toward the strip mall, one officer crouched at respectful distance with his back to us, others standing; late light, glass storefront behind the man, no device visible, no explosion, just a conversation across distance; sorrowful mood. Camera: one slow over-the-shoulder glide along the officer's sightline, stopping short of the man, whose face stays turned away.
shots.purpose: 他隔着封锁线求他们：我不骗你们

shots.camera: 移动车窗恒速侧跟 constant side track from car
shots.prompt: view from inside a moving police sedan sliding through 2003 small-city streets at 3 PM: bank frontage, fast-food window, plaza entrances and a tree-lined road toward a radio tower passing in steady parallax at window height, another patrol car pacing beside in mirror angle, stoplights and crosswalks empty of panic; only vehicles and storefronts, no pedestrians' faces. Camera: one continuous side tracking move filmed as if from the pacing second car, constant speed, the whole investigative loop passing once; no cuts inside the shot.
shots.purpose: 警方复跑任务路线：一步不差

shots.camera: 信息卡 static card
shots.purpose: 复跑结论卡：把灭口疑点钉成数字
shots.graphic: 跑不完｜警方按九页纸原路重跑 · 赶不上时限｜检方：没人打算让他拆下来

shots.camera: 固定机位长镜 locked-off single shot
shots.prompt: night interior of a suburban garage under a bare hanging bulb: an old chest freezer with a frosted lid sitting alone on bare concrete, a tall thin man in a bathrobe standing beside it holding a cordless phone to his ear, seen from well behind, the freezer still closed; a workbench, a coffee tin, the driveway dark beyond the open door; dread expressed only by the light; no body shown, nothing opened. Camera: locked-off wide from the garage entrance, no move except the bulb swinging one degree, holding on his back and the closed lid.
shots.purpose: 自首电话：冰柜与那盏灯

shots.camera: 信息卡 static card
shots.purpose: 冰柜事件卡：时间与人物关系
shots.graphic: 一通自首电话｜2003.09.20 报警 · 冰柜在自家车库｜报警的人正是帮着藏尸体的人

shots.camera: 证物墙横移 lateral track along evidence wall
shots.prompt: windowless federal case room at night: a corkboard wall covered with photos turned face-down or blurred, blank index cards, pushpins and colored string forming a web, a desk lamp throwing a warm cone, a pair of hands entering frame edge to pin one more blank card between three strings; no names written anywhere, no face; patient investigative texture. Camera: one slow lateral track along the whole board left to right ending on the densest knot of strings at the far edge.
shots.purpose: 两年调查：关系网在弦上

shots.camera: 门口后拉 dolly out through doorway
shots.prompt: an early-2010s American federal courtroom in morning light, jury box empty, a woman with gray hair seated at the defense table seen only from behind and far away, her lawyer's back beside her, flag in corner softly out of focus, dust in window light, silence and procedure; no gavel, no shouting, no faces readable. Camera: one slow backward glide pulling away from the gallery toward the open courtroom door, ending in the corridor with the doorframe boxing the gray-haired back.
shots.purpose: 审判画面：只给背影与程序

shots.camera: 镜面横移 slow lateral across glass
shots.prompt: a dim interview room seen through two-way glass corridor side: two men silhouette across a steel table, one leaning forward, one still, a single cup turned upside down, no readable papers, reflections of ceiling strip-lights sliding across the glass, the mood of a 2003 police transcript; both figures fully silhouetted, shapes only. Camera: one slow lateral track across the glass, reflections moving past the silhouettes, ending as the leaning figure settles back; no reveal.
shots.purpose: 交易与证词：网开始收紧

shots.camera: 走廊跟移 corridor follow
shots.prompt: muted green federal prison corridor, long line of fluorescent lights overhead: a short female silhouette being escorted away from camera far down the hall, both officers' backs to us, a cell door standing ajar at the end leaking cold daylight, floor wax reflecting the line of lights; no restraint close-ups, no faces, quiet routine. Camera: steady follow-behind tracking the escorted silhouette at constant distance for the full length of the corridor, ending as she passes the open door without turning.
shots.purpose: 收监：她的说法留在走廊尽头

shots.camera: 信息卡 static card
shots.purpose: 结论卡：只写判了什么
shots.graphic: 判决｜2010 三项罪名成立 · 次年无期加三十年｜上诉全部被驳回

shots.camera: 工作台缓拉 slow dolly-back to wide
shots.prompt: a suburban garage workbench in pale morning light through a half-open door, early autumn 2004: a canvas drop-cloth thrown over a small pile of bench tools and a lathe, a cold mug, a wall calendar with its page turned but unmarked, the whole bench abandoned mid-project; no person, nothing moving but dust in the light beam. Camera: one slow dolly-back pulling away until the whole bench sits framed inside the garage door, ending with the bright outside edge closing in.
shots.purpose: 未受审的人：先病故的造弹者

shots.camera: 垂直升镜 vertical crane-up
shots.prompt: night exterior of the tall lattice broadcast transmitter tower on the hill beyond the town, red aircraft warning lights blinking slowly, sodium parking-lot glow far below, thin fog on the mowed field, the tower standing like a question mark against a low cloud ceiling, no people, no cars moving; the same silhouette from the opening. Camera: one slow vertical crane-up from the foggy field level to the highest blinking red light, ending on open sky above the tower.
shots.purpose: 回到起点：发射塔仍未回答任何问题

shots.camera: 卷宗微距横移 macro glide along case file
shots.prompt: final desk shot: a closed paper case folder under a banker's lamp, a single rubber band stretched across it, one corner of an unlabeled photo peeking from under the band, an empty chair behind softly in focus, the lamp circle slowly narrowing around the folder; no names, no dates readable, nothing opened; the room goes quiet around it. Camera: one slow macro lateral glide along the folder edge ending centered on the rubber band, then a faint settle as light holds; no human hand enters.
shots.purpose: 案卷合而不结：把开放问题留在画面上
